verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so how quickly it adds new models is a fair question. The evidence only shows that a model catalog exists, listing each model's context, regions and price. Nothing in the pack covers how fast newly released open-weight models are added, so there is no documented capability for this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
